text: The best among you are those who have the best manners and character.
He who does not thank people, does not thank Allah.
Smiling in the face of your brother is charity.
None of you truly believes until he wishes for his brother what he wishes for himself.
When Allah loves a servant, He tests him.
How wonderful is the affair of the believer, for his affairs are all good, and this applies to no one but the believer.
No calamity befalls a Muslim but that Allah expiates some of his sins because of it, even if it be a thorn that pricks him.
Verily, along with hardship is relief. Verily, along with hardship is relief.
ref: Explained in Jami' at-Tirmidhi 3342, on Qur'an 94:5-6

text: Actions are judged by their intentions, and every person will be rewarded according to what they intended.
The strong believer is better and more beloved to Allah than the weak believer, while there is good in both.
Whoever puts his trust in Allah, He will be sufficient for him.
ref: Explained in Jami' at-Tirmidhi 2344, on Qur'an 65:3

text: Take advantage of five before five: your youth before your old age, your health before your sickness, your riches before your poverty, your free time before your work, and your life before your death.
